notes: Q4_0 and Q4_K are the same number of bytes in this repository (4197494816 exactly, both of them); confirm they are really two different quantizations before treating them as two configurations. The GGUF holds the transformer only. The text encoder and the VAE are separate files the runtime loads beside it, so size_gb is the file, not the resident footprint of a run — with a bf16 text encoder that is another 17.5 GB, and which text encoder was used belongs in the result's args. bits is the file's bytes x 8 / 7,115,124,736 transformer parameters, so it sits above the nominal width of the quantization because the f32 and f16 tensors are in the file too.
